import sys
from collections import deque

N = 10000
M = N * 100
inf = (1 << 63) - 1 >> 5

class FlowGraph:
    def __init__(self):
        self.head = [-1] * N
        self.v = [0] * M
        self.nxt = [-1] * M
        self.c = [0] * M
        self.w = [0] * M
        self.ptr = 0
        self.cost = 0
        self.dis = [-1] * N
        self.id = [0] * N
        self.cur = [-1] * N
        self.vis = [False] * N
        self.t = 0

    def padd_edge(self, u, v, w, c):
        self.v[self.ptr] = v
        self.w[self.ptr] = w
        self.c[self.ptr] = c
        self.nxt[self.ptr] = self.head[u]
        self.head[u] = self.ptr
        self.ptr += 1

    def add_edge(self, u, v, w, c):
        self.padd_edge(u, v, w, c)
        self.padd_edge(v, u, 0, -c)

    def spfa(self, s, t):
        for i in range(len(self.vis)):
            self.vis[i] = False
            self.dis[i] = -1
        q = deque()
        q.append(s)
        self.dis[s] = 0
        self.id[s] = 1
        while q:
            nd = q.popleft()
            self.vis[nd] = False
            i = self.head[nd]
            while i != -1:
                v = self.v[i]
                if self.w[i] and (self.dis[v] == -1 or self.dis[v] > self.dis[nd] + self.c[i]):
                    self.dis[v] = self.dis[nd] + self.c[i]
                    if not self.vis[v]:
                        self.vis[v] = True
                        q.append(v)
                i = self.nxt[i]
        return self.dis[t] != -1

    def dfs(self, pos, flow, t):
        if pos == t:
            return flow
        self.vis[pos] = True
        tmp = flow
        i = self.cur[pos] if self.cur[pos] != -1 else self.head[pos]
        while i != -1:
            v = self.v[i]
            if not self.vis[v] and self.w[i] and self.dis[v] == self.dis[pos] + self.c[i]:
                self.cur[pos] = i
                fl = self.dfs(v, min(flow, self.w[i]), t)
                self.cost += fl * self.c[i]
                self.w[i] -= fl
                self.w[i ^ 1] += fl
                flow -= fl
                if flow == 0:
                    break
            i = self.nxt[i]
        return tmp - flow

    def dinic(self, s, t):
        self.cost = 0
        self.t = t
        while self.spfa(s, t):
            for i in range(len(self.cur)):
                self.cur[i] = -1
            self.vis = [False] * len(self.vis)
            self.dfs(s, inf, t)
        return self.cost

g = FlowGraph()

n, m, kk, c, d = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
a = [0] + list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))

s = 0
t = n * 100 + 1

for i in range(1, 101):
    g.add_edge(i, t, inf, 0)

for i in range(1, kk + 1):
    g.add_edge(s, (a[i] - 1) * 100 + 1, 1, 0)

for i in range(2, n + 1):
    for j in range(1, 100):
        g.add_edge((i - 1) * 100 + j, (i - 1) * 100 + j + 1, inf, c)

for _ in range(m):
    t1, t2 = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
    for i in range(1, 100):
        val = c + d * (i * i - (i - 1) * (i - 1))
        g.add_edge((t1 - 1) * 100 + i, (t2 - 1) * 100 + i + 1, 1, val)
        g.add_edge((t2 - 1) * 100 + i, (t1 - 1) * 100 + i + 1, 1, val)

print(g.dinic(s, t))
